# Dolinhanh Bridal — Vietnam Wedding Gown

> Wedding dress house in Hanoi and Ho Chi Minh City, Vietnam (founded 2017, part of the Nupakachi wedding ecosystem). We sell ready-to-wear and made-to-measure wedding gowns to brides worldwide: most gowns US$880 to US$1,880, hand-finished beadwork and lace, delivered by DHL or FedEx. Video viewings and orders on WhatsApp +84 359 950 588.

## Key facts
- Showrooms (private fittings by appointment): 75 Nguyen Thi Dinh, Cau Giay, Hanoi · 2 Tan Canh, Tan Binh, Ho Chi Minh City
- Prices: most wedding gowns US$880 to US$1,880; the price of each gown is shown in the collection
- Buy from abroad: live WhatsApp video call to see the gown, measure at home, gown adjusted or made to measure, then shipped by DHL or FedEx (shipping fee and import duties paid by the bride)
- Made to measure, ordered online: production 3–4 months, 3 payments (30% · 50% · 20%), approval by photos, clips or video call at each step; order at least 4 months before the wedding
- Modest bridal: long sleeves, high necklines, sleeves added to a strapless gown, opaque lining; private room and a women-only team
- Sample sale: sample gowns 50% off, one of each, final sale
- Exchanges: if the gown received does not match its photos and description, we exchange it; no cash refunds
- Payment: bank transfer to our account in Vietnam (Wise, SWIFT or Remitly)

## Questions brides ask
- [How much does a wedding dress cost in Vietnam? (2026)](https://vietnamweddinggown.com/wedding-dress-cost-vietnam.html): At Dolinhanh Bridal, most wedding gowns are US$880 to US$1,880. One of our designs made new to your measurements is the gown price + US$300; a design of your own is quoted on WhatsApp. Shipping (about US$80–150) and import duties are extra.
- [How to order a wedding dress from Vietnam, step by step](https://vietnamweddinggown.com/order-wedding-dress-from-vietnam.html): Choose a gown, see it live on a WhatsApp video call, send your measurements, and we adjust it or make it for you, then ship it to your door by DHL or FedEx. Order about 6 months before your wedding.
- [Is it safe to order a wedding dress from Vietnam?](https://vietnamweddinggown.com/is-it-safe-to-order-wedding-dress-vietnam.html): Yes, if the shop has a real showroom, shows you the actual gown on a video call before you pay, confirms everything in writing and lets you pay in steps. Here is how to check any shop, including us.
- [Shipping a wedding dress from Vietnam to the USA or Canada](https://vietnamweddinggown.com/shipping-wedding-dress-vietnam-usa-canada.html): We send gowns by DHL or FedEx with tracking. A ready gown usually arrives 2–3 weeks after you order; shipping is about US$80–150, depending on the time of year, and import duties are paid by you.
- [Hanoi, Ho Chi Minh City or Hoi An: where to get your wedding dress in Vietnam?](https://vietnamweddinggown.com/hanoi-saigon-hoi-an-wedding-dress.html): Hoi An is famous for quick tailoring; Hanoi and Ho Chi Minh City have bridal houses where you can try finished wedding gowns in a private fitting. Dolinhanh Bridal has a showroom in both cities.
- [Modest long-sleeve wedding dresses made in Vietnam](https://vietnamweddinggown.com/modest-wedding-dress-vietnam.html): Dolinhanh Bridal has long-sleeve and high-neck wedding gowns ready in the collection, can add sleeves to a strapless gown, and fits you in a private room with a women-only team.
